name: inventory-apk
description: Aplikasi Inventory -- manajemen stok gudang Koperindo (Material, Opname, Stock In/Out, Partner, Logo), berbasis Cordova + jQuery + Tailwind + Vite

scripts.cordova:prepare: npm run build && node fix-platform-type.cjs && cordova prepare
scripts.cordova:android: npm run build && node fix-platform-type.cjs && cordova run android
scripts.cordova:ios: npm run build && node fix-platform-type.cjs && cordova run ios
